title.en: Environmental Protection and Management (Regulated GHG Works) Order 2022

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Environmental Protection and Management (Regulated GHG Works) Order 2022 and comes into operation on 1 October 2022.
3. The GHG works specified in the Schedule are regulated GHG works for the purposes of Part 10A of the Act, from and including the date specified opposite each of such works.
